title: The Aeropod automates soil aeration without robotics — see it at TechCrunch Disrupt | TechCrunch
summary: The device is “built like a seed, it sows like a seed, and it ships like a seed,” Ifeoluwa Afolayan, the company’s co-founder and CEO, told TechCrunch. The Aeropod should produce similar results at just £100 per hectare, Afolayan said.
